scenes.title_ar: لوريلاي تطلب قهوة الساعة خمس الفجر
scenes.title_en: Coffee at Five in the Morning

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.en: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Lorelai
lines.en: I need coffee.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.en: It's five in the morning. Make coffee at your own house.
lines.ar: الساعة خمس الفجر. سوّي قهوة في بيتك.

lines.speaker: Lorelai
lines.en: I did. I drank it all.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.en: You drank all the coffee in your house before five in the morning?
lines.ar: شربتي كل القهوة اللي في بيتك قبل الساعة خمس الفجر؟

lines.speaker: Lorelai
lines.en: Big gulps. Lots of sugar.

term.meaning_ar: كثير من، واجد، كمية كبيرة من
term.simple_en: a large amount or number of something
term.in_context: Lorelai puts a lot of sugar in her coffee.

quiz.q: What time is it when Lorelai comes to the diner?
quiz.explain_ar: لوك يقول: It's five in the morning.

scenes.title_ar: كريس يدخل مقابلة عمل بملابس الصبغ
scenes.title_en: The Job Interview in a Painted Shirt

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.en: So the truth is this... I was arrested for failure to pay parking tickets.
lines.ar: الحقيقة هي كالتالي… انقبض عليّ لأني ما دفعت مخالفات مواقف.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.en: Parking tickets?

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.en: And I ran all the way here from the Polk Station, the police station.
lines.ar: وجيت ركض طول الطريق من مركز بولك، مركز الشرطة.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.en: What were you doing before you were arrested?
lines.ar: وش كنت تسوي قبل ما ينقبض عليك؟

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.en: I was painting my apartment.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.en: Is it dry now?

term.meaning_ar: مخالفات مواقف، غرامات وقوف السيارات، قسائم مخالفة
term.simple_en: papers that tell you to pay money because you parked your car in the wrong place
term.in_context: Chris was arrested because he did not pay his parking fines.

quiz.q: Why is Chris wearing painting clothes at the interview?
options: He came straight from the police station after being arrested.
quiz.explain_ar: كان يصبغ شقته، وانقبض عليه بسبب المخالفات، وجا ركض من مركز الشرطة مباشرة.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.en: Well, look at it. Isn't it beautiful?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.en: Yeah, yeah. What is it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.en: It's a trifle.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.en: And it's got all of these layers.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.en: First, there's a layer of ladyfingers,

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.en: then a layer of jam,

term.simple_en: a flat amount of something that lies on or under another thing
term.in_context: The trifle is made of many layers of different foods, one on top of another.

quiz.explain_ar: قالت: It's a trifle. And it's got all of these layers.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: At least once a year, I like to bring in some of my Kevin's famous chili.
lines.ar: مرة في السنة على الأقل، أحب أجيب شوية من «تشيلي كيفن» المشهور.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: The trick is to undercook the onions.
lines.ar: السرّ إن البصل ما ينطبخ زيادة، يبقى نص استواء.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: Everybody is going to get to know each other in the pot.
lines.ar: كل المكونات بتتعرّف على بعضها داخل القدر.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: I'm serious about this stuff.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: I'm up the night before, pressing garlic and dicing whole tomatoes.
lines.ar: أسهر الليلة اللي قبلها أهرس الثوم وأقطّع طماطم كاملة مكعبات.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.en: I toast my own ancho chiles.

term.in_context: Kevin brings his chili one time a year or more.

quiz.q: How often does Kevin bring his chili to the office?
quiz.explain_ar: كيفن قال: At least once a year، يعني مرة في السنة على الأقل.
